about: Real YouTube searches for store songs: Deezer's title, artist and length for each song and the worker's own ytsearch5 query, run 28 Oct 2026, frozen. 'recording' lists the uploads that are the store's own recording (same performer, within 8 s, not another version); empty when none of the five is. 'padded' lists the artist's own official upload of the same song, longer (an intro). Labelled by hand; dev was looked at while the ranking was written, test was labelled before either ranking was run on it. See tests/accuracy/store_match.py.
